During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established a small '''outpost''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Galtea/Legends|Galtea]]. It was abandoned and destroyed in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].
